items.title: Trump-Xi meeting: Why China's self-sufficiency changes the calculus
items.summary: BEIJING — The trade deficit that escalated tensions between China and the U.S. in recent years has yet to shrink significantly, and the world's second-largest economy faces deep challenges.

items.title: CFTC says prediction markets' 'mentions' contracts present a higher risk of manipulation
items.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission advised some of its regulated entities on Tuesday that prediction markets' "mentions" contracts are at greater risk of manipulation.

items.title: Here's who we know is going to the Trump-Xi dinner so far
items.summary: BEIJING — With two days to go before Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected to land in the U.S., very little is known about which, if any, Chinese executives will join him.

items.title: Kalshi asks CFTC to allow margin trading on its platform, letting users buy with borrowed funds
items.summary: Prediction market platform Kalshi filed on Tuesday with federal regulators to seek approval to offer leverage on event contracts, a prevalent practice already on Wall Street for stocks and futures.
